objective: Assemble and independently verify the existing catalog-slug feature through the public workflow. compose_deterministic.sh writes slug.c and catalog-slug; verify.sh checks the sealed catalog.tar against normalization, bounds and CLI requirements, including missing behavior despite green exit.
assumptions: test_slug.c seeds output[0] with X before the NULL-input error case, so the clear-on-error contract is exercised from nonempty output; this is a strictly stronger check of the unchanged bounds criterion.

deliverables.description: Sealed source archive catalog.tar containing main.c, slug.c, slug.h and Makefile with the implemented slugify and the integrated catalog-slug command.

requirements.criterion: slugify maps ASCII letters to lowercase, keeps digits, collapses runs of other bytes into one hyphen between words, removes leading and trailing delimiters, yields the empty string for empty or delimiter-only input, and treats non-ASCII bytes as delimiters without claiming Unicode transliteration.

slugify(input, output, capacity) returns 0 and a terminated string on success; returns -1 when the result does not fit, input is NULL, output is NULL or capacity is zero; when output is non-NULL and capacity is positive every error leaves output[0] equal to zero; never writes outside capacity.

The existing catalog-slug command builds with strict C99 warnings, supports multiple arguments and --limit 1..64, fails an oversized slug with exit 2, and retains existing command argument error behavior.
